title: Multilingual embedding model
subtitle: the multilingual embedding model is the embedding model behind my code and reference search, served from a local text-embedding server.

lede: I treat an embedding model as a service with a contract and a failure mode, and I engineered how the model is served, cached and degraded around that. I did not train or fine-tune the multilingual embedding model. FAFOHive searches code, reference documents and stored observations for every agent seat in my estate, and every one of those searches starts with a dense embedding from the multilingual embedding model. The first versions tied GPU work to the life of the memory service, so I moved the model out of process, which keeps the service's lifecycle independent of the model's. The service's own API did not change in the move.
quote: The embedding dimension is a contract every consumer relies on, which let the serving backend change underneath without touching stored vectors or callers.
evidence: Embedding model serving: a multilingual embedding model moved out of process behind a local text-embedding server, with a cache so only misses reach the GPU.
Semantic code search: a code index of 19,204 documents and 294,362 chunks embedded for search across my monorepo.
